mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, MAX(IMAGE_PATH) KEEP ( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY CASE WHEN IS_MAIN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, IMAGE_NO ) AS MAIN_IMAGE FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE GROUP BY PRODUCT_NO ) PI ON PI.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT P
INNER JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO

SELECT RECOMMENDED.PRODUCT_NO, RECOMMENDED.BUSINESS_NO, RECOMMENDED.CONTENT_NO, RECOMMENDED.ACTOR_NO, RECOMMENDED.PRODUCT_NAME, RECOMMENDED.PRODUCT_TYPE, RECOMMENDED.PRICE, RECOMMENDED.DISCOUNT_RATE, RECOMMENDED.STOCK, RECOMMENDED.DESCRIPTION, RECOMMENDED.STATUS, RECOMMENDED.BUSINESS_NAME, RECOMMENDED.MAIN_IMAGE FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY CASE WHEN NVL(P.STOCK, 0) > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, NVL(P.DISCOUNT_RATE, 0) DESC, P.CREATED_AT DESC, P.PRODUCT_NO DESC ) AS RN, P.PRODUCT_NO, P.BUSINESS_NO, P.CONTENT_NO, P.ACTOR_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TYPE, P.PRICE, NVL(P.DISCOUNT_RATE, 0) AS DISCOUNT_RATE, NVL(P.STOCK, 0) AS STOCK, P.DESCRIPTION, P.STATUS, B.BUSINESS_NAME, PI.MAIN_IMAGE FROM PRODUCT P
INNER JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO
WHERE P.STATUS = 'ON_SALE' ) RECOMMENDED
WHERE RECOMMENDED.RN BETWEEN 1 AND #{limit}
ORDER BY RECOMMENDED.RN
SELECT DISTINCT P.PRODUCT_TYPE FROM PRODUCT P WHERE P.STATUS = 'ON_SALE' AND P.PRODUCT_TYPE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_TYPE

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO, P.BUSINESS_NO, P.CONTENT_NO, P.ACTOR_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TYPE, P.PRICE, NVL(P.DISCOUNT_RATE, 0) AS DISCOUNT_RATE, NVL(P.STOCK, 0) AS STOCK, P.DESCRIPTION, P.STATUS, B.BUSINESS_NAME, PI.MAIN_IMAGE FROM PRODUCT P
INNER JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO
WHERE P.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND P.STATUS = 'ON_SALE'

SELECT IMAGE_NO AS "imageNo", PRODUCT_NO AS "productNo", IMAGE_PATH AS "imagePath", IS_MAIN AS "isMain" FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} ORDER BY CASE WHEN IS_MAIN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, IMAGE_NO

SELECT C.CONTENT_NO AS "contentNo", C.TITLE AS "title", C.POSTER_PATH AS "posterPath", C.CONTENT_TYPE AS "contentType", C.TMDB_SCORE AS "tmdbScore" FROM PRODUCT P
INNER JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = P.CONTENT_NO
WHERE P.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND P.STATUS = 'ON_SALE'

SELECT A.ACTOR_NO AS "actorNo", A.ACTOR_NAME AS "actorName", A.PROFILE_PATH AS "profilePath" FROM PRODUCT P
INNER JOIN ACTOR A ON A.ACTOR_NO = P.ACTOR_NO
WHERE P.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND P.STATUS = 'ON_SALE' AND P.ACTOR_NO IS NOT NULL
